markets.title: Will the Fed cut rates at the September 2026 meeting?
markets.rules_primary: If the target federal funds rate announced by the FOMC at its September 2026 meeting is lowered by 25 basis points or more relative to the prior target, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The source is the FOMC statement published on federalreserve.gov.

markets.title: Will the S&P 500 close above 7000 on December 31, 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If the closing level of the S&P 500 index on December 31, 2026 is above 7000, then the market resolves to Yes. The source is the official close published by S&P Dow Jones Indices.

markets.title: Will Bitcoin be above $150,000 on December 31, 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If the price of Bitcoin as reported by the Coinbase BTC-USD spot index at 5pm ET on December 31, 2026 is above $150,000, then the market resolves to Yes.

markets.title: Who will win the 2026-27 Premier League?
markets.rules_primary: If Arsenal finish first in the 2026-27 Premier League season, then the market resolves to Yes. The source is the official Premier League final table.

markets.title: Will a streaming film win Best Picture at the 2027 Academy Awards?
markets.rules_primary: If the film that wins the Academy Award for Best Picture at the 2027 ceremony was distributed primarily by a streaming service, then the market resolves to Yes.

markets.title: Will the US enter a recession in 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If the NBER Business Cycle Dating Committee declares a recession with a peak occurring in 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
